description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the Android build system, including functions to retrieve environment paths such as the build root, output directories, native test paths, and system bin paths. It also handles errors related to missing environment variables or paths.

methods.name: GetTop()
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the Android build root by reading the ANDROID_BUILD_TOP environment variable.

methods.name: GetHostOutDir()
methods.description: Returns the path to the Android host output directory by reading ANDROID_HOST_OUT.

methods.name: GetOutDir()
methods.description: Returns the main output directory for the build, defaulting to 'out' under the top directory if OUT_DIR is not set.

methods.name: GetHostBin()
methods.description: Returns the path to the Android host binary directory, typically $ANDROID_HOST_OUT/bin.

methods.name: GetProductOut()
methods.description: Returns the target product output directory based on the ANDROID_PRODUCT_OUT environment variable.

methods.name: GetTargetNativeTestPath()
methods.description: Returns the path to the target native test directory under the product output.

methods.name: GetTargetSystemBin()
methods.description: Returns the path to the system/bin directory of the target product.

methods.name: GetHostLibraryPath()
methods.description: Returns the path to the host java library directory, typically $ANDROID_HOST_OUT/framework.

methods.name: GetTestAppPath()
methods.description: Returns the path to the build output directory of test applications, usually $ANDROID_PRODUCT_OUT/data/app.
